messages:
sarah: customer Acme Inc (acct: acct-9987) claims they accepted AWS Accelerator grant via Marketplace but credits are not visible in Redwood Console. Order ID: 123456-7890. They clicked 'Claim' and see 'No credits available'. Raised during support call.

mike: can you confirm if the marketplace webhook hit our entitlement service? i don't see any credit rows for acct-9987 in the billing ledger. any receipt from the customer?

sarah: they pasted the AWS confirmation email; includes Order ID above and AWS payer id 444433332222. forwarding to thread.

aws-marketplace-bot: webhook_event_received order_id=123456-7890 status=DELIVERED timestamp=1918199900 payload_customer_identifier=aws-acc-555 note: signature OK

alex: quick thought — we've seen mapping issues when customers register with different email/linked subaccount. ask them for the AWS payer id + the exact AWS account that claimed the grant (payer vs linked). also check our marketplace_entitlements table for any orphaned entries.

sam: ran a quick query on staging:
```
SELECT * FROM marketplace_entitlements WHERE order_id='123456-7890';
```
returned 0 rows. however SQS delivery logs show a payload where customer_identifier=aws-acc-555, which does not match acct-9987 mapping in our identity table. looks like the grant landed on a different internal tenant id.

jenny: repro checklist for support to provide the customer:
1) ask AWS to share the 'Marketplace order receipt' (PDF) and payer account id
2) ask customer to run locally: `aws marketplace-customer list-entitlements --product-code=redwood-inference --filter "CustomerIdentifier=aws-acc-555"` to confirm AWS thinks it assigned to aws-acc-555
3) send us the receipt + a screenshot of the claim success page

mike: i'm opening a partner case with AWS Marketplace (ref AWSP-34567) to request re-delivery or entitlement lookup. creating internal ticket TICKET-9123 to reconcile mappings and to reattach credits if needed. adding a short-term workaround: we can manually credit Acme while AWS investigates.

sarah: told customer we can apply manual credit pending AWS confirmation; they agreed to provide the receipt. customer also shared they used a different admin email when claiming — likely the linked account mismatch.

aws-marketplace-bot: AWSP case created AWSP-34567. ETA 48-72h for partner support response. updates will be posted here.

sarah: marking as P2, will follow up Monday if no update. assigning to mike + sam for reconciliation script patch (check alt identifiers). :thumbsup:
